The program has two nodes: one responsible for updating the Fibonacci sequence, and the other for controlling the loop. The append_to_list function is intended to add the newly generated fibonacci_list value to the fibonacci_list list in the graph state. I originally thought that append_to_list would be called only once after the n1 node finishes execution, and that the final result would be a complete Fibonacci sequence.
